000037: function ensureDailyGemsLoaded() {
000038:   if (dailyGemsModule) return Promise.resolve(dailyGemsModule);
000039:   if (!dailyGemsLoadPromise) {
000040:     dailyGemsLoadPromise = import(`./daily-gems.js?v=${VERSION}`)
000041:       .then((module) => {
000042:         dailyGemsModule = module;
000043:         return module;
000044:       })
000045:       .catch((error) => {
000046:         dailyGemsLoadPromise = null;
000047:         throw error;
000048:       });
000049:   }
000050:   return dailyGemsLoadPromise;
000051: }
000052:

000610: function runEventEmergencySettlement(key, eventState) {
000611:   if (!key || !eventState) return false;
000612:   const stage = String(eventState.stage || '');
000613:   let changed = false;
000614: 
000615:   switch (key) {
000616:     case 'westernUnionEvent':
000617:       // 「いいえ」を選んだ場合や、まだ名前確認中の場合は報酬を付与しない。
000618:       if (['gift', 'explain1', 'explain2', 'explain3'].includes(stage) && !eventState.rewardGranted) {
000619:         grantWesternUnionAntiqueDiamond(eventState);
000620:         changed = true;
000621:       }
000622:       break;
000623: 
000624:     case 'miningPazupanEvent':
000625:       if (!eventState.rewardGranted) { grantPazupan(eventState); changed = true; }
000626:       break;
000627: 
000628:     case 'mermaidEvent':
000629:       if (!eventState.rewardGranted) { grantMermaidPearl(eventState); changed = true; }
000630:       break;
000631: 
000632:     case 'tattooWomanAmberEvent':
000633:       if (!eventState.rewardGranted) {
000634:         adjustLooseInventory(TATTOO_WOMAN_AMBER_EVENT_GEM_ID, TATTOO_WOMAN_AMBER_EVENT_SHAPE_ID, 1);
000635:         eventState.rewardGranted = true;
000636:         addNotification('琥珀を手に入れました', '工房のルースへ追加されました。', 'special');
000637:         changed = true;
000638:       }
000639:       break;
000640: 
000641:     case 'kappaJadeEvent':
000642:       changed = grantEmergencyRough(eventState, 'jade', '翡翠原石を手に入れました', '工房の原石へ追加されました。研磨すると翡翠のルースになります。') || changed;
000643:       break;

000794: function eventRecord(key, targetState = state) {
000795:   if (!targetState) return null;
000796:   targetState.events = targetState.events && typeof targetState.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(targetState.events) ? targetState.events : {};
000797:   const value = targetState.events[key];
000798:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) targetState.events[key] = {};
000799:   return targetState.events[key];
000800: }

000802: function recoverPaidChildhoodFriendMeal(eventState) {
000803:   if (!state || !eventState?.mealPaid || eventState.mealCompleted) return false;
000804:   state.wellbeing = state.wellbeing && typeof state.wellbeing === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.wellbeing) ? state.wellbeing : {};
000805:   const maxHunger = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state.wellbeing.maxHunger) || 7));
000806:   const current = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxHunger, Math.floor(Number(state.wellbeing.hunger) || 0)));
000807:   const recovery = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(MEALS.ramen?.recovery) || 3));
000808:   eventState.hungerBefore = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxHunger, Math.floor(Number(eventState.hungerBefore) || current)));
000809:   state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(maxHunger, current + recovery);
000810:   eventState.hungerAfter = state.wellbeing.hunger;
000811:   eventState.mealCompleted = true;
000812:   return true;
000813: }

002564: function validPositivePrice(value) {
002565:   const price = Number(value);
002566:   return Number.isFinite(price) && price > 0 && price < 100000000;
002567: }
002568: 
002569: function metalMarketTimestampMs() {
002570:   const date = new Date(metalMarket.updatedAt || metalMarket.marketTimestamp || '');
002571:   return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? date.getTime() : 0;
002572: }
002573: 
002574: function metalMarketTradeReady() {
002575:   if (!['live', 'cached'].includes(metalMarket.status)) return false;
002576:   const purchase = metalMarket.purchasePerGramByMetalId || {};
002577:   const sell = metalMarket.sellPerGramByMetalId || {};
002578:   if (!['silver', 'gold', 'platinum'].every((id) => validPositivePrice(purchase[id]) && validPositivePrice(sell[id]))) return false;
002579:   // 最終正常取得値は、経過日数だけを理由に売買停止しない。
002580:   // 価格形式と取得日時が正常な「最後に検証済みの相場」であることだけを必須とする。
002581:   return metalMarketTimestampMs() > 0;
002582: }

002584: function cachedMetalMarketPayload() {
002585:   try {
002586:     const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(METAL_MARKET_CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
002587:     return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
002588:   } catch (_) {
002589:     return null;
002590:   }
002591: }
002592: 
002593: function saveMetalMarketCache(data) {
002594:   try {
002595:     localStorage.setItem(METAL_MARKET_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ savedAt: new Date().toISOString(), data }));
002596:   } catch (_) {}
002597: }
002598: 
002599: function restoreCachedMetalMarket() {
002600:   const cached = cachedMetalMarketPayload();
002601:   if (!cached?.data) return false;
002602:   const cachedTimestamp = new Date(cached.data.updatedAt || cached.data.marketTimestamp || cached.savedAt || '').getTime();
002603:   // オフラインやAPI停止が長期化しても、最後に検証済みの正常キャッシュを利用できるようにする。
002604:   if (!Number.isFinite(cachedTimestamp)) return false;
002605:   try {
002606:     applyMetalMarketData(cached.data, { statusOverride: 'cached' });
002607:     return true;
002608:   } catch (error) {
002609:     console.warn('保存済み地金相場を復元できませんでした。', error);
002610:     try { localStorage.removeItem(METAL_MARKET_CACHE_KEY); } catch (_) {}
002611:     return false;
002612:   }
002613: }

002615: function metalPriceDateLabel(value) {
002616:   const date = new Date(value || '');
002617:   if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return '';
002618:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ja-JP', {
002619:     timeZone: 'Asia/Tokyo', year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric',
002620:     hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false,
002621:   }).format(date);
002622: }

002624: function metalMarketDateLabel(value, includeYear = true) {
002625:   const match = String(value || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
002626:   if (!match) return '';
002627:   const [, year, month, day] = match;
002628:   return includeYear ? `${Number(year)}年${Number(month)}月${Number(day)}日` : `${Number(month)}月${Number(day)}日`;
002629: }

002634: }

002636: function metalMarketIsStale() {
002637:   const date = new Date(metalMarket.updatedAt || metalMarket.marketTimestamp || '');
002638:   return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) && Date.now() - date.getTime() > METAL_MARKET_STALE_NOTICE_MS;

002641: function normalizeMetalHistory(rawHistory, currentSpot = {}, currentDate = null) {
002642:   const byDate = new Map();
002643:   if (Array.isArray(rawHistory)) {
002644:     rawHistory.forEach((entry) => {
002645:       const date = String(entry?.date || '');
002646:       if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) return;
002647:       const spot = entry?.spotPerGram || {};
002648:       const normalized = {
002649:         gold: validSpotPrice(spot.gold) ? Number(spot.gold) : null,
002650:         platinum: validSpotPrice(spot.platinum) ? Number(spot.platinum) : null,
002651:         silver: validSpotPrice(spot.silver) ? Number(spot.silver) : null,
002652:       };
002653:       if (Object.values(normalized).every(validSpotPrice)) byDate.set(date, { date, spotPerGram: normalized });
002654:     });
002655:   }
002656:   const date = String(currentDate || '');
002657:   if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) && ['gold', 'platinum', 'silver'].every((id) => validSpotPrice(currentSpot[id]))) {
002658:     byDate.set(date, {
002659:       date,
002660:       spotPerGram: {
002661:         gold: Number(currentSpot.gold),
002662:         platinum: Number(currentSpot.platinum),
002663:         silver: Number(currentSpot.silver),
002664:       },
002665:     });
002666:   }
002667:   return [...byDate.values()].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
002668: }
002669: 
002670: function realJstDateParts() {
002671:   const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ja-JP', {
002672:     timeZone: 'Asia/Tokyo', year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric',
002673:   }).formatToParts(new Date());
002674:   const values = Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, Number(part.value)]));
002675:   return { year: values.year, month: values.month, day: values.day };
002676: }
002677: 
002678: function metalHistoryReferenceParts() {
002679:   const match = String(metalMarket.marketDateJst || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
002680:   if (match) return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]), day: Number(match[3]) };
002681:   return realJstDateParts();
002682: }

002684: function applyMetalMarketData(data, options = {}) {
002685:   const purchasePacks = data?.gamePurchasePrices || {};
002686:   const sellPacks = data?.gameSellPrices || {};
002687:   const purchasePerGram = data?.gamePurchasePricesPerGram || data?.gamePricesPerGram || {};
002688:   const sellPerGram = data?.gameSellPricesPerGram || {};
002689:   const resolvePerGram = (perGram, packs, productId, alloy) => {
002690:     if (validPositivePrice(perGram[alloy])) return Number(perGram[alloy]);
002691:     const pack = packs[productId] || {};
002692:     if (validPositivePrice(pack.price) && validPositivePrice(pack.grams)) return Number(pack.price) / Number(pack.grams);
002693:     return NaN;
002694:   };
002695:   const purchaseMapped = {
002696:     silver: resolvePerGram(purchasePerGram, purchasePacks, 'silver', 'SV925'),
002697:     gold: resolvePerGram(purchasePerGram, purchasePacks, 'gold', 'K18'),
002698:     platinum: resolvePerGram(purchasePerGram, purchasePacks, 'platinum', 'Pt900'),
002699:   };
002700:   const legacySellPrice = (id, purchasePrice) => {
002701:     const ratios = { silver: 0.90 / 1.30, gold: 0.98 / 1.15, platinum: 0.94 / 1.15 };
002702:     const unit = id === 'silver' ? 1 : 10;
002703:     return Math.round((Number(purchasePrice) * ratios[id]) / unit) * unit;
002704:   };
002705:   const sellMapped = {
002706:     silver: resolvePerGram(sellPerGram, sellPacks, 'silver', 'SV925'),
002707:     gold: resolvePerGram(sellPerGram, sellPacks, 'gold', 'K18'),
002708:     platinum: resolvePerGram(sellPerGram, sellPacks, 'platinum', 'Pt900'),
002709:   };
002710:   Object.keys(sellMapped).forEach((id) => {
002711:     if (!validPositivePrice(sellMapped[id])) sellMapped[id] = legacySellPrice(id, purchaseMapped[id]);
002712:   });
002713:   if (!Object.values(purchaseMapped).every(validPositivePrice) || !Object.values(sellMapped).every(validPositivePrice)) {
002714:     throw new Error('地金の購入価格・売却価格データの形式が正しくありません。');
002715:   }
002716:   Object.entries(purchaseMapped).forEach(([id, perGramPrice]) => {
002717:     METALS[id].price = Math.round(Number(perGramPrice));
002718:   });
002719: 
002720:   const spotSource = data?.spotPerGram || {};
002721:   const previousSpotSource = data?.previousSpotPerGram || {};
002722:   const changeSource = data?.changeFromPreviousDayPerGram || {};
002723:   const spotMapped = {
002724:     gold: validSpotPrice(spotSource.gold) ? Number(spotSource.gold) : null,
002725:     platinum: validSpotPrice(spotSource.platinum) ? Number(spotSource.platinum) : null,
002726:     silver: validSpotPrice(spotSource.silver) ? Number(spotSource.silver) : null,
002727:   };
002728:   const previousSpotMapped = {
002729:     gold: validSpotPrice(previousSpotSource.gold) ? Number(previousSpotSource.gold) : null,
002730:     platinum: validSpotPrice(previousSpotSource.platinum) ? Number(previousSpotSource.platinum) : null,
002731:     silver: validSpotPrice(previousSpotSource.silver) ? Number(previousSpotSource.silver) : null,
002732:   };
002733:   const changeMapped = Object.fromEntries(['gold', 'platinum', 'silver'].map((id) => {
002734:     const rawChange = changeSource[id];
002735:     const supplied = Number(rawChange);
002736:     if (rawChange !== null && rawChange !== '' && Number.isFinite(supplied)) return [id, supplied];
002737:     if (validSpotPrice(spotMapped[id]) && validSpotPrice(previousSpotMapped[id])) return [id, spotMapped[id] - previousSpotMapped[id]];
002738:     return [id, null];
002739:   }));
002740: 
002741:   metalMarket = {
002742:     status: options.statusOverride || (data.status === 'live' ? 'live' : 'cached'),
002743:     sourceName: String(data?.source?.name || 'Metals.Dev'),
002744:     updatedAt: data.updatedAt || null,
002745:     marketTimestamp: data.marketTimestamp || null,
002746:     marketDateJst: data.marketDateJst || null,
002747:     previousMarketDateJst: data.previousMarketDateJst || null,
002748:     spotPerGramByBaseId: spotMapped,
002749:     previousSpotPerGramByBaseId: previousSpotMapped,
002750:     changePerGramByBaseId: changeMapped,
002751:     historyRetentionYears: Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.floor(Number(data.historyRetentionYears) || 5))),
002752:     historyDaily: normalizeMetalHistory(data.historyDaily, spotMapped, data.marketDateJst),
002753:     purchasePerGramByMetalId: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(purchaseMapped).map(([id, price]) => [id, Math.round(Number(price))])),
002754:     sellPerGramByMetalId: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(sellMapped).map(([id, price]) => [id, Math.round(Number(price))])),
002755:   };
002756: }

002758: async function loadMetalMarket() {
002759:   const hadUsableMarket = metalMarketTradeReady() || restoreCachedMetalMarket();
002760:   if (!hadUsableMarket && !['live', 'cached'].includes(metalMarket.status)) metalMarket.status = 'loading';
002761:   const controller = new AbortController();
002762:   const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), METAL_MARKET_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS);
002763:   try {
002764:     const response = await fetch('./data/metals.json', { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
002765:     if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
002766:     const data = await response.json();
002767:     applyMetalMarketData(data);
002768:     saveMetalMarketCache(data);
002769:   } catch (error) {
002770:     console.warn('地金相場を読み込めませんでした。正常な前回価格があれば継続使用し、なければ売買を停止します。', error);
002771:     const restored = metalMarket.status === 'cached' || restoreCachedMetalMarket();
002772:     if (!restored && metalMarket.status !== 'live') {
002773:       metalMarket = {
002774:         ...METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK,
002775:         spotPerGramByBaseId: { ...METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK.spotPerGramByBaseId },
002776:         previousSpotPerGramByBaseId: { ...METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK.previousSpotPerGramByBaseId },
002777:         changePerGramByBaseId: { ...METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK.changePerGramByBaseId },
002778:         historyRetentionYears: METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK.historyRetentionYears,
002779:         historyDaily: [],
002780:         purchasePerGramByMetalId: { ...METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK.purchasePerGramByMetalId },
002781:         sellPerGramByMetalId: { ...METAL_MARKET_FALLBACK.sellPerGramByMetalId },
002782:       };
002783:     }
002784:   } finally {
002785:     window.clearTimeout(timeout);
002786:   }
002787: }

002789: // Restore the last validated real-world market synchronously before the first supplier render.

002792: function metalMarketSummary() {
002793:   const timestamp = metalPriceDateLabel(metalMarket.updatedAt || metalMarket.marketTimestamp);
002794:   if (metalMarket.status === 'loading') {
002795:     return `<div class="metal-market-summary fallback"><strong>地金相場を取得中</strong><small>価格確認が完了するまで地金の売買はできません。</small></div>`;
002796:   }
002797:   if (!['live', 'cached'].includes(metalMarket.status)) {
002798:     return `<div class="metal-market-summary fallback"><strong>地金相場を取得できません</strong><small>誤った価格での売買を防ぐため、地金の売買を停止しています。</small></div>`;
002799:   }
002800:   const stale = metalMarketIsStale();
002801:   const tradeReady = metalMarketTradeReady();
002802:   const title = metalMarket.status === 'cached' || stale ? '前回取得した地金相場' : '現実の地金相場と連動してます';
002803:   const caution = !tradeReady ? '　価格情報が不完全なため売買停止中' : stale ? '　最終取得価格で売買中' : '';
002804:   return `<div class="metal-market-summary ${stale || !tradeReady ? 'stale' : ''}"><strong>${title}</strong><small>最終更新：${esc(timestamp)}　取得元：${esc(metalMarket.sourceName)}${caution}</small></div>`;
002805: }

002807: function metalSpotDifferenceMarkup(id) {
002808:   const difference = Number(metalMarket.changePerGramByBaseId?.[id]);
002809:   if (!Number.isFinite(difference)) return '<span class="metal-spot-change unavailable">前日比 ─</span>';
002810:   const rounded = Math.round(difference);
002811:   if (rounded > 0) return `<span class="metal-spot-change up">＋${yen(rounded)}</span>`;
002812:   if (rounded < 0) return `<span class="metal-spot-change down">−${yen(Math.abs(rounded))}</span>`;
002813:   return '<span class="metal-spot-change flat">±0円</span>';
002814: }

002855: function metalHistoryRangeLimits() {
002856:   const current = metalHistoryReferenceParts();
002857:   const currentMonthIndex = current.year * 12 + current.month - 1;
002858:   const months = Math.max(12, Math.min(60, Number(metalMarket.historyRetentionYears || 5) * 12));
002859:   return {
002860:     current,
002861:     currentMonthIndex,
002862:     minimumMonthIndex: currentMonthIndex - months + 1,
002863:     minimumYear: current.year - Math.max(1, Math.floor(months / 12)) + 1,
002864:   };
002865: }

002867: function metalHistoryMonthSelection() {

002896: function metalHistoryMonthlyAverages(year) {
002897:   const monthly = new Map();
002898:   (metalMarket.historyDaily || []).forEach((entry) => {
002899:     if (!entry.date.startsWith(`${year}-`)) return;
002900:     const month = Number(entry.date.slice(5, 7));
002901:     if (!monthly.has(month)) monthly.set(month, { month, count: 0, gold: 0, platinum: 0, silver: 0 });
002902:     const aggregate = monthly.get(month);
002903:     aggregate.count += 1;
002904:     METAL_HISTORY_SERIES.forEach(({ id }) => { aggregate[id] += Number(entry.spotPerGram[id]); });
002905:   });
002906:   return [...monthly.values()].sort((a, b) => a.month - b.month).map((aggregate) => ({
002907:     date: `${year}-${String(aggregate.month).padStart(2, '0')}`,
002908:     x: aggregate.month,
002909:     spotPerGram: Object.fromEntries(METAL_HISTORY_SERIES.map(({ id }) => [id, aggregate[id] / aggregate.count])),
002910:   }));
002911: }

002913: function metalHistoryChartSvg(rows, series, maximumX, xTicks, labelForRow) {
002914:   const values = rows.map((row) => Number(row.spotPerGram?.[series.id])).filter(validSpotPrice);
002915:   if (!values.length) return '<div class="metal-history-empty">この期間の相場記録はありません。</div>';
002916:   const width = 640;
002917:   const height = 184;
002918:   const left = 76;
002919:   const right = 18;
002920:   const top = 14;
002921:   const bottom = 34;
002922:   const plotWidth = width - left - right;
002923:   const plotHeight = height - top - bottom;
002924:   let minimum = Math.min(...values);
002925:   let maximum = Math.max(...values);
002926:   const naturalSpan = maximum - minimum;
002927:   const padding = naturalSpan > 0 ? naturalSpan * .12 : Math.max(1, maximum * .02);
002928:   minimum = Math.max(0, minimum - padding);
002929:   maximum += padding;
002930:   const span = Math.max(1e-9, maximum - minimum);
002931:   const xFor = (x) => left + (Math.max(1, Math.min(maximumX, x)) - 1) / Math.max(1, maximumX - 1) * plotWidth;
002932:   const yFor = (value) => top + (maximum - value) / span * plotHeight;
002933:   const pointRows = rows.filter((row) => validSpotPrice(row.spotPerGram?.[series.id]));
002934:   const points = pointRows.map((row) => `${xFor(row.x).toFixed(1)},${yFor(Number(row.spotPerGram[series.id])).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
002935:   const grid = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map((ratio) => {
002936:     const y = top + plotHeight * ratio;
002937:     return `<line x1="${left}" y1="${y.toFixed(1)}" x2="${width - right}" y2="${y.toFixed(1)}" class="metal-chart-grid"/>`;
002938:   }).join('');
002939:   const yLabels = [
002940:     { y: top + 4, value: maximum },
002941:     { y: top + plotHeight + 4, value: minimum },
002942:   ].map((entry) => `<text x="${left - 8}" y="${entry.y.toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end" class="metal-chart-axis-label">${yen(Math.round(entry.value))}</text>`).join('');
002943:   const xLabels = xTicks.map((tick) => `<text x="${xFor(tick.x).toFixed(1)}" y="${height - 9}" text-anchor="middle" class="metal-chart-axis-label">${esc(tick.label)}</text>`).join('');
002944:   const circles = pointRows.map((row) => {
002945:     const value = Number(row.spotPerGram[series.id]);
002946:     return `<circle cx="${xFor(row.x).toFixed(1)}" cy="${yFor(value).toFixed(1)}" r="3.2" fill="${series.color}" class="metal-chart-point"><title>${esc(labelForRow(row))}　${yen(Math.round(value))}／g</title></circle>`;
002947:   }).join('');
002948:   return `<svg class="metal-line-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(series.label)}の相場推移">
002949:     ${grid}${yLabels}${xLabels}
002950:     ${points ? `<polyline points="${points}" fill="none" stroke="${series.color}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>` : ''}
002951:     ${circles}
002952:   </svg>`;
002953: }

002970: function renderSupplierMetalHistory() {

003011:             <button type="button" class="secondary-button" data-action="metal-history-shift" data-direction="1" ${nextDisabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>${range === 'year' ? '翌年' : '次月'}</button>
003012:           </div>

003019:         <button type="button" class="primary-button full-button metal-history-close" data-action="metal-history-close">閉じる</button>

003024: function metalStorageLimit(id) {
003025:   const configured = Number(state?.inventory?.metalCapacity?.[id]);
003026:   return Math.max(1, Number.isFinite(configured) ? configured : Number(METALS[id]?.storageLimit) || 1);
003027: }
003028: 
003029: function metalOwnedWeight(id) {
003030:   return roundedMetalWeight(state?.inventory?.metals?.[id]);
003031: }
003032: 
003033: function metalReservedWeight(id, excludeOrderId = '') {
003034:   if (!Array.isArray(state?.orders)) return 0;
003035:   const reserved = state.orders.reduce((total, order) => {
003036:     if (!order || order.id === excludeOrderId || order.metal !== id || order.jewelryId || ['完成', '完了', '取消', '期限切れ'].includes(order.status)) return total;
003037:     const fallback = Number(ITEMS[order.item]?.metalWeight) || Number(METALS[id]?.unitWeight) || 0;
003038:     return total + Math.max(0, Number(order.requiredMetalWeight) || fallback);
003039:   }, 0);
003040:   return roundedMetalWeight(reserved);
003041: }
003042: 
003043: function metalAvailableWeight(id, excludeOrderId = '') {
003044:   return roundedMetalWeight(Math.max(0, metalOwnedWeight(id) - metalReservedWeight(id, excludeOrderId)));
003045: }

003051: function metalTradePricePerGram(mode, id) {
003052:   if (!metalMarketTradeReady()) return 0;
003053:   const table = mode === 'sell' ? metalMarket.sellPerGramByMetalId : metalMarket.purchasePerGramByMetalId;
003054:   const price = Number(table?.[id]);
003055:   return validPositivePrice(price) ? Math.round(price) : 0;
003056: }

003058: function metalTradeMaximum(mode, id) {
003059:   if (!metalMarketTradeReady()) return 0;
003060:   const owned = metalOwnedWeight(id);
003061:   if (mode === 'sell') return Math.max(0, Math.floor(metalAvailableWeight(id) + 1e-9));
003062:   const capacityRemaining = Math.max(0, metalStorageLimit(id) - owned);
003063:   const affordable = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money || 0) / metalTradePricePerGram('buy', id)));
003064:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(capacityRemaining + 1e-9), affordable));
003065: }

011478: function syncTodayGemHeaderLayout() {

011494: 
011495: function visibleHeaderBottom(headerEl) {
011496:   if (!(headerEl instanceof HTMLElement)) return 0;
011497:   let bottom = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
011498:   const elements = [headerEl, ...headerEl.querySelectorAll('*')];
011499:   for (const element of elements) {
011500:     if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
011501:     const styles = getComputedStyle(element);
011502:     if (styles.display === 'none' || styles.visibility === 'hidden') continue;
011503:     const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
011504:     if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) continue;
011505:     bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom);
011506:   }
011507:   return bottom;
011508: }

011838: function timeRemainingLabel(minutes) {
011839:   const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(minutes) || 0));
011840:   const hours = Math.floor(remaining / 60);
011841:   const restMinutes = remaining % 60;
011842:   if (hours > 0 && restMinutes > 0) return `あと${hours}時間${restMinutes}分`;
011843:   if (hours > 0) return `あと${hours}時間`;
011844:   return `あと${restMinutes}分`;
011845: }

011847: function gameTimePanel() {
011848:   const minutes = Math.max(DAY_START_MINUTES, Number(state?.game?.minutes) || DAY_START_MINUTES);
011849:   const clockTone = minutes >= 19 * 60 ? 'time-red' : minutes >= 17 * 60 ? 'time-yellow' : 'time-default';
011850:   let tone = 'normal';
011851:   let note = '';
011852:   if (minutes >= DAY_END_MINUTES) {
011853:     tone = 'ended';
011854:     note = '本日の行動時間は終了しました';
011855:   } else if (minutes >= DAY_END_MINUTES - 60) {
011856:     tone = 'ending';
011857:     note = `行動終了まで ${timeRemainingLabel(DAY_END_MINUTES - minutes)}`;
011858:   } else if (minutes >= OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES - 60 && minutes < OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES) {
011859:     tone = 'okachimachi-warning';
011860:     note = `御徒町終了まで ${timeRemainingLabel(OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES - minutes)}`;
011861:   }
011862:   return `<span class="jwj-status-item jwj-status-time game-time-panel ${tone} ${clockTone}" role="status" aria-label="現在時刻 ${clock(minutes)}${note ? `、${esc(note)}` : ''}" ${note ? `title="${esc(note)}"` : ''}>${clock(minutes)}</span>`;
011863: }

011956: function captureSettingsScrollState() {

012510: function orderMinimumProfitablePrice(request = {}) {
012511:   const looseShape = normalizeLooseShape(request.gem, request.looseShape);
012512:   const draft = { ...request, looseShape, finish: 'mirror', quality: 'standard' };
012513:   const materialCost = Math.max(0, Math.round(productionCost(draft)));
012514:   const difficultyId = orderDifficultyId(request);
012515:   const laborFee = ORDER_LABOR_FEES[difficultyId] || ORDER_LABOR_FEES.basic;
012516:   const profitAllowance = Math.max(5000, Math.round(materialCost * 0.35));
012517:   return roundThousand(materialCost + laborFee + profitAllowance);
012518: }
012519: 
012520: function normalizeOrderRequestBudget(request = {}) {
012521:   const normalized = { ...request };
012522:   normalized.looseShape = normalizeLooseShape(normalized.gem, normalized.looseShape);
012523:   const minimumBudget = orderMinimumProfitablePrice(normalized);
012524:   normalized.budget = roundThousand(Math.max(minimumBudget, Number(normalized.budget) || 0));
012525:   return normalized;
012526: }

012528: function customerRequestSignature(request = {}) {

012530:     request.item || '',
012531:     request.gem || '',
012532:     normalizeLooseShape(request.gem, request.looseShape),
012533:     request.metal || '',
012534:     request.design || '',
012535:   ].join('|');
012536: }

012538: function randomCustomerPreference(request = {}) {
012539:   const preferences = [
012540:     { type: 'gem', value: request.gem, label: GEMS[request.gem]?.name || '石指定' },
012541:     { type: 'metal', value: request.metal, label: METALS[request.metal]?.name || '地金指定' },
012542:     { type: 'design', value: request.design, label: DESIGNS[request.design]?.name || 'デザイン指定' },
012543:   ];
012544:   return structuredClone(randomFrom(preferences, preferences[0]));
012545: }
012546: 
012547: function buildRandomCustomerVisitRequest(customerId, branchNumber) {
012548:   const customer = CUSTOMERS[customerId];
012549:   const baseRequest = structuredClone(customer?.request || {});
012550:   const branch = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(branchNumber) || 1)));
012551:   const allGemIds = Object.values(GEMS).filter((gem) => !gem.eventOnly).map((gem) => gem.id);
012552:   const commonGemIds = allGemIds.filter((gemId) => !HIGH_VALUE_GEMS.includes(gemId));
012553:   const gemPool = branch === 3 ? HIGH_VALUE_GEMS.filter((gemId) => GEMS[gemId]) : (commonGemIds.length ? commonGemIds : allGemIds);
012554:   const metalPool = branch === 3 ? HIGH_VALUE_METALS.filter((metalId) => METALS[metalId]) : Object.keys(METALS);
012555:   const request = {
012556:     ...baseRequest,
012557:     item: randomFrom(Object.keys(ITEMS), baseRequest.item || 'ring'),
012558:     gem: randomFrom(gemPool, baseRequest.gem || 'amethyst'),
012559:     metal: randomFrom(metalPool, baseRequest.metal || 'silver'),
012560:     design: randomFrom(Object.keys(DESIGNS), baseRequest.design || 'simple'),
012561:   };
012562:   request.looseShape = randomFrom(looseShapeIdsForGem(request.gem), defaultLooseShapeForGem(request.gem));
012563:   request.difficulty = customerVisitDifficulty(branch, baseRequest.difficulty || 'basic');
012564:   request.requiredArtisanLevel = ORDER_DIFFICULTIES[request.difficulty]?.artisanLevel || 1;
012565:   request.deadlineDays = ORDER_DIFFICULTIES[request.difficulty]?.days || 7;
012566:   request.requiredTools = Array.isArray(baseRequest.requiredTools) && baseRequest.requiredTools.length
012567:     ? [...new Set(baseRequest.requiredTools.map(String))]
012568:     : ['jewelryBench'];
012569:   request.preference = randomCustomerPreference(request);
012570:   const quality = branch === 3 ? 'premium' : branch === 2 ? 'good' : 'standard';
012571:   const recommended = recommendedPrice({ ...request, quality, useLoose: true });
012572:   const budgetRate = branch === 3
012573:     ? 1.15 + Math.random() * 0.35
012574:     : branch === 2
012575:       ? 1.05 + Math.random() * 0.25
012576:       : 0.95 + Math.random() * 0.25;
012577:   request.budget = roundThousand(recommended * budgetRate);
012578:   request.storeProfile = branch === 3 ? 'premium' : branch === 2 ? 'quality' : 'general';
012579:   return normalizeOrderRequestBudget(request);
012580: }
012581: 
012582: function customerVisitRequest(customerId, branchNumber) {
012583:   const customerState = state?.customers?.[customerId];
012584:   const previousSignature = String(customerState?.lastRequestSignature || customerRequestSignature(customerState?.activeRequest || {}));
012585:   let candidate = null;
012586:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 16; attempt += 1) {
012587:     candidate = buildRandomCustomerVisitRequest(customerId, branchNumber);
012588:     if (!previousSignature || customerRequestSignature(candidate) !== previousSignature) return candidate;
012589:   }
012590:   // 極端に同じ抽選が続いた場合も、デザインを必ず次へ送って前回と同じ要望にならないようにする。
012591:   const designIds = Object.keys(DESIGNS);
012592:   const currentIndex = Math.max(0, designIds.indexOf(candidate?.design));
012593:   candidate.design = designIds[(currentIndex + 1) % designIds.length] || 'simple';
012594:   candidate.preference = { type: 'design', value: candidate.design, label: DESIGNS[candidate.design]?.name || 'デザイン指定' };
012595:   return normalizeOrderRequestBudget(candidate);
012596: }

013631: async function loadCinemaEventVideos() {
013632:   if (!cinemaEventVideosPromise) {
013633:     cinemaEventVideosPromise = (async () => {
013634:       const controller = new AbortController();
013635:       const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
013636:       try {
013637:         const response = await fetch(CINEMA_EVENT_VIDEO_MANIFEST_URL, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
013638:         if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`cinema video manifest ${response.status}`);
013639:         const data = await response.json();
013640:         const raw = Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.videos) ? data.videos : [];
013641:         return [...new Set(raw.map(normalizeCinemaEventVideoName).filter(Boolean))];
013642:       } catch (error) {
013643:         console.warn('映画館イベントの動画一覧を読み込めませんでした。', error);
013644:         cinemaEventVideosPromise = null;
013645:         return [];
013646:       } finally {
013647:         window.clearTimeout(timeout);
013648:       }
013649:     })();
013650:   }
013651:   return cinemaEventVideosPromise;
013652: }

014644: function grayHoodAquariumEventState() {
014645:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
014646:   const saved = state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent && typeof state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent)
014647:     ? state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent : {};
014648:   const dialogueStages = new Set(['intro1', 'intro2', 'intro3', 'reward', 'farewell', 'unlockMessage']);
014649:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'video', ...dialogueStages, 'completed']);
014650:   const rawStage = validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle';
014651:   const rawResumeStage = dialogueStages.has(saved.stageAfterVideo) ? saved.stageAfterVideo : '';
014652:   Object.assign(saved, {
014653:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
014654:     completed: Boolean(saved.completed),
014655:     stage: rawStage,
014656:     triggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.triggeredDay) || 0)),
014657:     introVideoCompleted: Boolean(saved.introVideoCompleted),
014658:     stageAfterVideo: rawResumeStage,
014659:   });
014660:   if (saved.completed) {
014661:     saved.active = false;
014662:     saved.stage = 'completed';
014663:     saved.introVideoCompleted = true;
014664:     saved.stageAfterVideo = '';
014665:   } else if (saved.active && !saved.introVideoCompleted) {
014666:     // v0.10.579より前にイベント途中だったセーブでも、重要な導入動画を飛ばさず
014667:     // 視聴後に元の進行段階へ正確に戻す。
014668:     if (saved.stage !== 'video') saved.stageAfterVideo = dialogueStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : (saved.stageAfterVideo || 'intro1');
014669:     if (!saved.stageAfterVideo) saved.stageAfterVideo = 'intro1';
014670:     saved.stage = 'video';
014671:   }
014672:   state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent = saved;
014673:   return saved;
014674: }

014680: function startGrayHoodAquariumIntroPlayback() {
014681:   const e = grayHoodAquariumEventState();
014682:   if (!e.active || e.stage !== 'video') return;
014683:   const video = root.querySelector('video[data-gray-hood-aquarium-intro-video]');
014684:   if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
014685:   const stage = video.closest('.gray-hood-aquarium-video-stage');
014686:   stage?.classList.remove('needs-start', 'has-error');
014687:   video.muted = false;
014688:   video.volume = 1;
014689:   suspendAudio();
014690:   const playPromise = video.play();
014691:   if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
014692:     playPromise
014693:       .then(() => {
014694:         stage?.classList.add('is-playing');
014695:         stage?.classList.remove('needs-start', 'has-error');
014696:       })
014697:       .catch(() => stage?.classList.add('needs-start'));

015486: function availableMiningLocations() {

015492: function unlockMiningLocationsIfNeeded() {
015493:   const progress = state.miningProgress;
015494:   const newlyUnlocked = [];
015495:   for (const location of Object.values(MINING_LOCATIONS)) {
015496:     if (progress.successfulFinds >= Number(location.unlockAtFinds || 0)
015497:       && !progress.unlockedLocations.includes(location.id)) {
015498:       progress.unlockedLocations.push(location.id);
015499:       newlyUnlocked.push(location);
015500:       addNotification('新しい採掘場所を発見しました', `${location.name}で採掘できるようになりました。`);
015501:     }
015502:   }
015503:   return newlyUnlocked;
015504: }

016097: function renderSupplierMetals() {

016099:   const normalizedView = requestedView === 'metalBuy' || requestedView === 'metals' || requestedView === 'buy' ? 'buy'
016100:     : requestedView === 'metalSell' || requestedView === 'sell' ? 'sell'

016103:   const mode = view === 'sell' ? 'sell' : 'buy';

016105:   const products = view === 'sell'
016106:     ? orderedMetals.filter((product) => metalOwnedWeight(product.id) > 0)
016107:     : orderedMetals;

016109:   const productRows = view === 'market' || !tradeReady ? '' : products.map((product) => {

016115:     const quantity = metalTradeQuantity(mode, product.id);
016116:     const perGram = metalTradePricePerGram(mode, product.id);
016117:     const disabled = !tradeReady || quantity < 1 || !canSpendHours(1);

016146:         </span></div>

016148:       </div>`}

016151:       ${mode === 'sell' && reserved > 0 ? '<p class="small-note metal-fraction-note">注文に使用予定の地金は売却できません。</p>' : mode === 'sell' && owned > 0 && maximum < 1 ? '<p class="small-note metal-fraction-note">1g未満の端数は所持品に残ります。</p>' : ''}
016152:     </article>`;
016153:   }).join('');

016155:   const marketContent = `

016160:       <button type="button" class="secondary-button large-button full-button" data-action="metal-trade-open" data-mode="sell" ${tradeReady ? '' : 'disabled'}>地金を売る</button>

016164:     <div class="product-list metal-trade-list">
016165:       ${!tradeReady
016166:         ? '<div class="empty-state sell-empty-state"><strong>地金相場を確認できないため売買を停止しています。</strong><small>地金相場へ戻り「相場を再取得」を押してください。</small></div>'
016167:         : (productRows || (view === 'sell' ? '<div class="empty-state sell-empty-state"><strong>売却できる地金はありません。</strong></div>' : ''))}

016209: function renderLooseShop(forcedTab = '') {
016210:   const requestedTab = forcedTab || screenData.tab || 'buy';
016211:   const tab = ['buy', 'sell', 'rough'].includes(requestedTab) ? requestedTab : 'buy';
016212:   const isSelling = tab === 'sell';
016213:   const isRoughSelling = tab === 'rough';
016214:   const selectedGem = isRoughSelling ? null : (GEMS[screenData.gemId] || null);
016215: 
016216:   let shopContent = '';
016217:   if (isRoughSelling) {
016218:     shopContent = roughSaleContentMarkup();
016219:   } else if (!selectedGem) {
016220:     const gems = Object.values(GEMS).filter((gem) => {
016221:       if (isSelling) return !gem.noLooseShopTrade && looseTotalForGem(gem.id) > 0;
016222:       return !gem.eventOnly;
016223:     });
016224:     const gemChoices = gems.map((gem) => {
016225:       const owned = looseTotalForGem(gem.id);
016226:       const available = looseAvailableTotalForGem(gem.id);
016227:       const status = isSelling
016228:         ? `<small>所持：${owned}個・売却可能：${available}個</small>`
016229:         : '';
016230:       return `<button type="button" class="loose-shop-gem-choice" data-action="select-loose-shop-gem" data-id="${esc(gem.id)}">
016231:         ${looseVisual(gem.id, 'loose-shop-gem-image', '', defaultLooseShapeForGem(gem.id))}
016232:         <span><strong>${esc(gem.name)}</strong>${status}</span>
016233:         <i aria-hidden="true">›</i>
016234:       </button>`;
016235:     }).join('');
016236:     shopContent = `<section class="loose-shop-gem-selection">
016237:       <header class="loose-shop-step-heading"><h2>石種を選択</h2></header>
016238:       <div class="loose-shop-gem-grid">
016239:         ${gemChoices || '<div class="empty-state sell-empty-state"><strong>売却できるルースはありません。</strong><p>所持しているルースがある場合、石種がここに表示されます。</p></div>'}
016240:       </div>
016241:     </section>`;
016242:   } else {
016243:     const rows = looseVariantRows({ ownedOnly: isSelling }).filter((entry) => entry.gem.id === selectedGem.id);
016244:     const productRows = rows.map(({ shapeId, shape, owned, reserved, available }) => {
016245:       const purchasePrice = loosePurchasePrice(selectedGem.id, shapeId);
016246:       const salePrice = looseSalePrice(selectedGem.id, shapeId);
016247:       const detailButton = `<button class="secondary-button" data-action="open-loose-detail" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}">詳細</button>`;
016248:       const tradeLocked = Boolean(selectedGem.noLooseShopTrade);
016249:       if (isSelling) {
016250:         const disabled = tradeLocked || available < 1 || !canSpendHours(1);
016251:         return `<article class="product-row loose-shop-product-row">
016252:           <div class="product-main">
016253:             ${looseVisual(selectedGem.id, 'loose-inline', '', shapeId)}
016254:             <div><strong>${esc(selectedGem.id === 'pearl' ? selectedGem.name : shape.name)}</strong><small>所持：${owned}個</small><small>注文予定：${reserved}個・売却可能：${available}個</small></div>
016255:           </div>
016256:           <strong>${yen(salePrice)}／個</strong>
016257:           <div class="loose-shop-actions">${detailButton}<button class="primary-button" data-action="sell-loose" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>1個売る</button><button class="secondary-button" data-action="sell-all-loose" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>全部売る</button></div>
016258:         </article>`;
016259:       }
016260:       const maximum = loosePurchaseMaximum(selectedGem.id, shapeId);
016261:       const quantity = loosePurchaseQuantity(selectedGem.id, shapeId);
016262:       const disabled = quantity < 1 || !canSpendHours(1);
016263:       return `<article class="product-row loose-shop-product-row">
016264:         <div class="product-main">
016265:           ${looseVisual(selectedGem.id, 'loose-inline', '', shapeId)}
016266:           <div><strong>${esc(selectedGem.id === 'pearl' ? selectedGem.name : shape.name)}</strong><small>所持：${owned}個</small>${reserved > 0 ? `<small>注文予定：${reserved}個・使用可能：${available}個</small>` : ''}</div>
016267:         </div>
016268:         <strong>${yen(purchasePrice)}／個</strong>
016269:         <div class="loose-shop-actions loose-shop-buy-actions" data-loose-purchase-card="${selectedGem.id}:${shapeId}">
016270:           ${detailButton}
016271:           <div class="loose-purchase-quantity">
016272:             <span class="loose-quantity-label">数</span>
016273:             <span class="metal-vertical-stepper loose-vertical-stepper" aria-label="購入数を増減">
016274:               <button type="button" class="metal-stepper-button metal-stepper-up" data-action="loose-qty-step" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" data-delta="1" aria-label="${esc(shape.name)}を1個増やす。長押しで連続増加" ${quantity >= maximum ? 'disabled' : ''}>▲</button>
016275:               <span class="metal-input-wrap loose-input-wrap"><output class="quantity-readout" data-loose-purchase-value aria-live="polite" aria-label="${esc(shape.name)}の購入数">${quantity}</output><b>個</b></span>
016276:               <button type="button" class="metal-stepper-button metal-stepper-down" data-action="loose-qty-step" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" data-delta="-1" aria-label="${esc(shape.name)}を1個減らす。長押しで連続減少" ${quantity <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>▼</button>
016277:             </span>

016279:           </div>
016280:           <button class="primary-button loose-inline-purchase" data-action="purchase" data-kind="loose" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>購入する</button>
016281:         </div>
016282:       </article>`;
016283:     }).join('');
016284:     shopContent = `<section class="loose-shop-cut-selection">
016285:       <button type="button" class="secondary-button loose-shop-gem-back" data-action="loose-shop-gem-back">← 石種一覧へ戻る</button>
016286:       <div class="product-list loose-shop-cut-list">
016287:         ${productRows || '<div class="empty-state sell-empty-state"><strong>この石種で売却できるルースはありません。</strong><p>別の石種を選択してください。</p></div>'}
016288:       </div>
016289:       <button type="button" class="secondary-button loose-shop-gem-back loose-shop-gem-back-bottom" data-action="loose-shop-gem-back">← 石種一覧へ戻る</button>
016290:     </section>`;
016291:   }

016299:           <button class="${tab === 'sell' ? 'active' : ''}" data-action="loose-shop-tab" data-tab="sell">ルースを売る</button>
016300:           <button class="${tab === 'rough' ? 'active' : ''}" data-action="loose-shop-tab" data-tab="rough">原石を売る</button>
016301:         </div>
016302:         ${shopContent}
016303:       </section>
016304:     </div>`);

016306: 
016307: function jewelryShopRandomQuality() {
016308:   const roll = Math.random();
016309:   if (roll < 0.55) return 'standard';
016310:   if (roll < 0.88) return 'good';
016311:   return 'premium';
016312: }
016313: 
016314: function jewelryShopPurchaseRecommendedPrice(purchasePrice) {
016315:   const price = Math.max(1000, Math.round(Number(purchasePrice) || 0));
016316:   return Math.max(price + 1000, roundThousand(price * 1.08));
016317: }
016318: 
016319: function createJewelryShopStockItem() {
016320:   const item = randomFrom(Object.keys(ITEMS), 'ring');
016321:   const metal = randomFrom(Object.keys(METALS), 'silver');
016322:   const gem = randomFrom(Object.values(GEMS).filter((entry) => !entry.eventOnly).map((entry) => entry.id), 'amethyst');
016323:   const useLoose = Math.random() >= 0.12;
016324:   const looseShape = randomFrom(looseShapeIdsForGem(gem), defaultLooseShapeForGem(gem));
016325:   const design = randomFrom(Object.keys(DESIGNS), 'simple');
016326:   const finish = randomFrom(Object.keys(FINISHES), 'mirror');
016327:   const quality = jewelryShopRandomQuality();
016328:   const draft = { item, metal, gem, useLoose, looseShape, design, finish, quality };
016329:   const marketValue = recommendedPrice(draft);
016330:   const purchasePrice = Math.max(1000, roundThousand(marketValue * (0.90 + Math.random() * 0.06)));
016331:   return {
016332:     id: `jewelry-shop-${uid()}`,
016333:     ...draft,
016334:     name: itemName(draft),
016335:     marketValue,
016336:     purchasePrice,
016337:     recommendedPrice: jewelryShopPurchaseRecommendedPrice(purchasePrice),
016338:   };
016339: }
016340: 
016341: function createJewelryShopStock() {
016342:   return Array.from({ length: JEWELRY_SHOP_STOCK_SIZE }, () => createJewelryShopStockItem());
016343: }
016344: 
016345: function jewelryShopSellOffer(item) {
016346:   const cost = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(item?.cost) || 0));
016347:   if (!cost) return 0;
016348:   if (item?.acquisition === 'jewelryShop') return Math.max(1000, roundThousand(cost * 0.78));
016349:   // 御徒町のジュエリーショップへの売却は卸販売。利益はごく小さくする。
016350:   const multiplier = item?.quality === 'premium' ? 1.04 : item?.quality === 'good' ? 1.03 : 1.02;
016351:   return Math.max(cost + 1000, roundThousand(cost * multiplier));
016352: }
016353: 
016354: function jewelryShopProductVisual(item) {
016355:   return `<div class="small-jewelry jewelry-shop-item-visual metal-${item.metal} item-${item.item}" style="--gem:${GEMS[item.gem]?.hue || '#ffffff'}">${jewelryItemVisual(item.item, 'jewelry-item-shape small', item.useLoose !== false)}${item.useLoose !== false ? `<i>${jewelryLooseSetVisual(item.item, item.gem, item.looseShape, 'small')}</i>` : ''}</div>`;
016356: }
016357: 
016358: function jewelryShopHeroMarkup(mode) {
016359:   const src = mode === 'buy'
016360:     ? `./assets/images/jewelry-shop-buy-character.png?v=${VERSION}`
016361:     : mode === 'sell'
016362:       ? `./assets/images/jewelry-shop-sell-character.png?v=${VERSION}`
016363:       : '';
016364:   if (!src) return '';
016365:   return `<div class="jewelry-shop-hero-layer jewelry-shop-hero-${mode}" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${src}" alt=""></div>`;
016366: }

016368: function renderJewelryShop() {
016369:   const mode = screenData.mode || '';
016370:   if (!mode) {
016371:     return shell('ジュエリーショップ', `
016372:       <div class="split-layout">
016373:         <section class="scene-space"></section>
016374:         <section class="action-panel glass-panel jewelry-shop-menu-panel">
016375:           <div class="button-stack">
016376:             <button type="button" class="primary-button full-button" data-action="jewelry-shop-open-sell">ジュエリーを売る</button>
016377:             <button type="button" class="secondary-button full-button" data-action="jewelry-shop-open-buy">ジュエリーを買う</button>
016378:           </div>
016379:           <p class="small-note">売却時の利益と、購入品を再販売した時の利益はどちらも小さめです。売買手続きには1時間かかります。</p>
016380:         </section>
016381:       </div>`, { help: 'ジュエリーショップでは、保管中の完成品を売却したり、入店ごとに変わる商品を購入したりできます。' });
016382:   }
016383: 
016384:   if (mode === 'buy') {
016385:     if (!Array.isArray(screenData.stock)) screenData.stock = createJewelryShopStock();
016386:     const usedCapacity = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
016387:     const capacityFull = usedCapacity >= state.inventory.capacity;
016388:     const rows = screenData.stock.map((item) => {
016389:       const estimatedProfit = item.recommendedPrice - item.purchasePrice;
016390:       const disabled = capacityFull || state.game.money < item.purchasePrice || !canSpendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS);
016391:       return `<article class="jewelry-shop-product-card">
016392:         ${jewelryShopProductVisual(item)}
016393:         <div class="jewelry-shop-product-copy">
016394:           <h3>${esc(item.name)}</h3>
016395:           <small>${esc(QUALITIES[item.quality]?.name || '')}・${esc(DESIGNS[item.design]?.name || '')}</small>
016396:           <div class="jewelry-shop-price-row"><span>購入価格</span><strong>${yen(item.purchasePrice)}</strong></div>
016397:           <div class="jewelry-shop-profit-row"><span>購入後のおすすめ価格</span><b>${yen(item.recommendedPrice)}</b><small>利益目安 ${yen(estimatedProfit)}</small></div>
016398:         </div>
016399:         <button type="button" class="primary-button jewelry-shop-trade-button" data-action="jewelry-shop-buy" data-id="${esc(item.id)}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>この商品を買う</button>
016400:       </article>`;
016401:     }).join('');
016402:     return shell('ジュエリーを買う', `
016403:       <div class="split-layout jewelry-shop-layout-with-hero">
016404:         ${jewelryShopHeroMarkup('buy')}
016405:         <section class="scene-space"></section>
016406:         <section class="action-panel glass-panel jewelry-shop-panel jewelry-shop-panel-with-hero">
016407:           <div class="jewelry-shop-panel-content">
016408:             <button type="button" class="secondary-button jewelry-shop-back" data-action="jewelry-shop-menu">← メニューへ戻る</button>
016409:             <div class="jewelry-shop-status-row"><span>完成品保管</span><strong>${usedCapacity}／${state.inventory.capacity}</strong></div>
016410:             ${capacityFull ? '<p class="error-text">完成品の保管場所に空きがありません。</p>' : ''}
016411:             <p class="small-note jewelry-shop-trade-note jewelry-shop-random-note">商品は「ジュエリーを買う」を開くたびにランダムで入れ替わります。仕入れ価格が高いため、再販売しても大きな利益は出ません。</p>
016412:             <div class="jewelry-shop-product-list">${rows || '<div class="empty-state"><strong>商品は売り切れました。</strong><p>メニューへ戻り、もう一度「ジュエリーを買う」を開くと商品が入れ替わります。</p></div>'}</div>
016413:           </div>
016414:         </section>
016415:       </div>`, { help: '表示された商品から購入できます。購入品は工房の完成品へ追加され、店舗のショーケースへ陳列できます。' });
016416:   }
016417: 
016418:   const items = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status === 'stored');
016419:   const rows = items.map((item) => {
016420:     const offer = jewelryShopSellOffer(item);
016421:     const profit = offer - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
016422:     const disabled = !canSpendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS);
016423:     return `<article class="jewelry-shop-product-card">
016424:       ${jewelryShopProductVisual(item)}
016425:       <div class="jewelry-shop-product-copy">
016426:         <h3>${esc(item.name)}</h3>
016427:         <small>${esc(QUALITIES[item.quality]?.name || '')}・原価 ${yen(item.cost)}</small>
016428:         <div class="jewelry-shop-price-row"><span>卸買取価格</span><strong>${yen(offer)}</strong></div>
016429:         <div class="jewelry-shop-profit-row ${profit < 0 ? 'loss' : ''}"><span>利益</span><b>${profit >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}${yen(Math.abs(profit))}</b></div>
016430:       </div>
016431:       <button type="button" class="primary-button jewelry-shop-trade-button" data-action="jewelry-shop-sell" data-id="${esc(item.id)}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>この商品を売る</button>
016432:     </article>`;
016433:   }).join('');
016434:   return shell('ジュエリーを売る', `
016435:     <div class="split-layout jewelry-shop-layout-with-hero">
016436:       ${jewelryShopHeroMarkup('sell')}
016437:       <section class="scene-space"></section>
016438:       <section class="action-panel glass-panel jewelry-shop-panel jewelry-shop-panel-with-hero">
016439:         <div class="jewelry-shop-panel-content">

016471: function confirmJewelryShopTrade() {
016472:   const pending = jewelryShopPendingTrade;
016473:   jewelryShopPendingTrade = null;
016474:   closeModal();
016475:   if (!pending) return;
016476:   if (!canSpendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS)) return showToast('今日は売買手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
016477: 
016478:   if (pending.type === 'buy') {
016479:     const stockItem = Array.isArray(screenData.stock) ? screenData.stock.find((item) => item.id === pending.itemId) : null;
016480:     if (!stockItem) return showToast('この商品は売り切れました。', 'error');
016481:     const usedCapacity = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
016482:     if (usedCapacity >= state.inventory.capacity) return showToast('完成品の保管場所に空きがありません。', 'error');
016483:     if (state.game.money < stockItem.purchasePrice) return showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
016484:     const purchased = {
016485:       id: uid(), item: stockItem.item, metal: stockItem.metal, gem: stockItem.gem, useLoose: stockItem.useLoose,
016486:       looseShape: stockItem.looseShape, design: stockItem.design, finish: stockItem.finish, quality: stockItem.quality,
016487:       name: stockItem.name, cost: stockItem.purchasePrice, recommendedPrice: stockItem.recommendedPrice, xp: 0,
016488:       status: 'stored', createdDay: state.game.day, purchasedDay: state.game.day,
016489:       acquisition: 'jewelryShop', shopPurchasePrice: stockItem.purchasePrice,
016490:     };
016491:     state.game.money -= stockItem.purchasePrice;
016492:     state.inventory.jewelry.push(purchased);
016493:     screenData.stock = screenData.stock.filter((item) => item.id !== pending.itemId);
016494:     spendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS);
016495:     addFinance(`ジュエリーショップで${purchased.name}を購入`, 0, stockItem.purchasePrice);
016496:     saveGame();
016497:     startMoneyFeedback(-stockItem.purchasePrice);
016498:     showToast(`${purchased.name}を購入しました。`, 'info', false);
016499:     render();
016500:     return;
016501:   }
016502: 
016503:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === pending.itemId && entry.status === 'stored');
016504:   if (!item) return showToast('この商品は現在売却できません。', 'error');
016505:   const offer = jewelryShopSellOffer(item);
016506:   const profit = offer - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
016507:   removeJewelry(item.id, { price: offer, channel: 'jewelryShop' });
016508:   state.game.money += offer;
016509:   spendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS);
016510:   state.daily.sold.push({ itemId: item.id, name: item.name, price: offer, profit, channel: 'jewelryShop' });
016511:   addFinance(`${item.name}をジュエリーショップへ卸販売`, offer, 0);
016512:   saveGame();
016513:   startMoneyFeedback(offer);
016514:   showToast(`${item.name}を${yen(offer)}で卸販売しました。`, 'info', false);
016515:   render();
016516: }

016658:   if (state.workshop.processingKnowledge.some((entry) => String(entry?.id || entry) === id)) return false;
016659:   state.workshop.processingKnowledge.push({ id, acquiredDay: Math.max(1, Number(state.game?.day) || 1), source: String(source || 'イベント').slice(0, 120) });

016661:   return true;

016716: function workshopStaffUnlockStatus() {

016947: function craftLooseGemChoice(orderId = null) {

016963:         : looseAvailableTotalForGem(gem.id);

017190: function renderProcessingKnowledgeDocument(document) {
017191:   const sections = Array.isArray(document?.sections) ? document.sections : [];
017192:   const references = Array.isArray(document?.references) ? document.references : [];
017193:   const opening = [document?.overview, document?.body].filter(Boolean).map((value) => String(value));
017194:   const wordCount = opening.join('').length + sections.reduce((total, section) => total
017195:     + (Array.isArray(section?.paragraphs) ? section.paragraphs.join('').length : String(section?.body || '').length)
017196:     + (Array.isArray(section?.points) ? section.points.join('').length : 0), 0);
017197:   return `<article class="tool-learning-guide processing-knowledge-document">
017198:     <div class="tool-guide-stats" aria-label="加工知識の収録範囲">
017199:       <strong>加工資料 全${Math.max(1, sections.length)}章</strong>
017200:       <span>本文約${wordCount.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}字</span>
017201:       ${references.length ? `<span>参考資料${references.length}件</span>` : ''}
017202:       ${document?.revision ? `<span>改訂 ${esc(document.revision)}</span>` : ''}
017203:     </div>
017204:     ${opening.map((paragraph, index) => `<p class="${index === 0 ? 'tool-guide-lead' : ''}">${esc(paragraph)}</p>`).join('')}
017205:     ${sections.length > 1 ? `<details class="tool-guide-toc"><summary>目次を開く</summary><ol>${sections.map((section, index) => `<li><a href="#processing-knowledge-section-${index + 1}">${esc(section.title || '')}</a></li>`).join('')}</ol></details>` : ''}
017206:     ${sections.map((section, index) => {
017207:       const paragraphs = Array.isArray(section?.paragraphs) ? section.paragraphs : (section?.body ? [section.body] : []);
017208:       const points = Array.isArray(section?.points) ? section.points : [];
017209:       return `<section class="tool-guide-section" id="processing-knowledge-section-${index + 1}">
017210:         <div class="tool-guide-chapter-number">${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</div>
017211:         <h3>${esc(section.title || '')}</h3>
017212:         ${paragraphs.map((paragraph) => `<p>${esc(paragraph)}</p>`).join('')}
017213:         ${points.length ? `<ul>${points.map((point) => `<li>${esc(point)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : ''}
017214:       </section>`;
017215:     }).join('')}
017216:     ${references.length ? `<section class="tool-guide-section tool-guide-references"><h3>参考資料</h3><ul>${references.map((reference) => `<li>${esc(reference)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></section>` : ''}
017217:   </article>`;
017218: }

017472: function metalInventoryMetrics(metalId) {
017473:   const owned = metalOwnedWeight(metalId);
017474:   const reserved = metalReservedWeight(metalId);
017475:   const available = metalAvailableWeight(metalId);
017476:   const capacity = metalStorageLimit(metalId);
017477:   const remaining = metalRemainingCapacity(metalId);

017582: function storeTheftEventState() {
017583:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
017584:   const saved = state.events.storeTheftEvent && typeof state.events.storeTheftEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.storeTheftEvent)
017585:     ? state.events.storeTheftEvent
017586:     : {};
017587:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'intro1', 'choice', 'declined', 'intro2', 'intro3', 'farewell', 'pause', 'theftNotice', 'completed']);
017588:   state.events.storeTheftEvent = {
017589:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
017590:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
017591:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
017592:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
017593:     branchId: String(saved.branchId || ''),
017594:     branchNumber: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(saved.branchNumber) || 1)),
017595:     targetItemId: String(saved.targetItemId || ''),
017596:     targetItemName: String(saved.targetItemName || ''),
017597:     theftApplied: Boolean(saved.theftApplied),
017598:   };
017599:   if (!state.events.storeTheftEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.storeTheftEvent.stage)) {
017600:     state.events.storeTheftEvent.stage = 'completed';
017601:   }
017602:   return state.events.storeTheftEvent;
017603: }
017604: 
017605: function maybeStartStoreTheftEvent(branch = currentStoreBranch()) {
017606:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
017607:   const eventState = storeTheftEventState();
017608:   if (eventState.active) {
017609:     const activeBranchId = eventState.branchId || branch?.id || '';
017610:     setScreen('storeTheftEvent', activeBranchId ? { branchId: activeBranchId } : {}, false);
017611:     return true;
017612:   }
017613:   if (!branch) return false;
017614:   const candidates = robberyItemsInBranch(branch);
017615:   if (!candidates.length) return false;
017616:   if (!markVisitEventCheckOncePerDay(eventState)) return false;
017617:   if (Math.random() >= STORE_THEFT_EVENT_CHANCE) {
017618:     saveGame();
017619:     return false;
017620:   }
017621:   const target = randomFrom(candidates, candidates[0]);
017622:   if (!target?.item) return false;
017623:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;
017624:   eventState.active = true;

018027: function updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(price, savedPrice, item) {
018028:   if (screen !== 'showcaseDetail' || !item) return false;
018029:   const panel = root.querySelector('.showcase-detail-panel');
018030:   if (!panel) return false;
018031:   const normalizedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(price, item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice || 1000);
018032:   const normalizedSavedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(savedPrice, item.recommendedPrice || normalizedPrice);
018033:   const priceStatus = sellingPriceStatus(item, normalizedPrice);
018034:   const expectedProfit = normalizedPrice - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
018035:   const priceValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-value]');
018036:   const expectedProfitValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-expected-profit]');
018037:   const priceStatusValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-status]');
018038:   const confirmButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-confirm]');
018039:   const downButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-down]');
018040:   if (priceValue) priceValue.textContent = yen(normalizedPrice);
018041:   if (expectedProfitValue) expectedProfitValue.textContent = yen(expectedProfit);
018042:   if (priceStatusValue) {
018043:     priceStatusValue.textContent = priceStatus.name;
018044:     priceStatusValue.className = `price-status ${priceStatus.id}`;
018045:   }
018046:   if (confirmButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) confirmButton.disabled = normalizedPrice === normalizedSavedPrice;
018047:   if (downButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) downButton.disabled = normalizedPrice <= 1000;
018048:   return Boolean(priceValue && expectedProfitValue && priceStatusValue && confirmButton && downButton);
018049: }

018123: function customerPreferenceMatches(item, request) {
018124:   const preference = request?.preference || { type: 'gem', value: request?.gem };
018125:   if (preference.type === 'metal') return item.metal === preference.value;
018126:   if (preference.type === 'design') return item.design === preference.value;
018127:   if (item.useLoose === false) return false;
018128:   if (preference.type === 'color') {
018129:     const acceptedGems = Array.isArray(preference.gems) ? preference.gems : [];
018130:     return acceptedGems.includes(item.gem);
018131:   }
018132:   return item.gem === preference.value;
018133: }
018134: 
018135: function customerMatchResult(item, request, branchNumber = state?.store?.branchNumber || 1) {
018136:   const price = sellingPriceForJewelry(item);
018137:   const budget = Math.max(1000, Number(request?.budget) || 1000);
018138:   const matches = Number(item.item === request?.item)
018139:     + Number(price <= budget)
018140:     + Number(customerPreferenceMatches(item, request));
018141:   const farOverBudget = price > budget * 1.25;
018142:   const labels = ['ほとんど売れない', '売れにくい', '購入の可能性あり', 'かなり売れやすい'];
018143:   const chances = [0.05, 0.20, 0.55, 0.90];
018144:   const salesStaff = activeStoreStaff(branchNumber);
018145:   // v0.10.628: 店舗スタッフの有無を接客購入率へ大きく反映する。
018146:   // 無人時は接客力不足で-10pt、配置中は基礎+10ptにスタッフLvの購入率ボーナスを加える。
018147:   const staffingPurchaseModifier = salesStaff
018148:     ? 0.10 + storeStaffPurchaseBonus(branchNumber)
018149:     : -0.10;
018150:   const baseChance = chances[matches] + storeProductSaleBonus(item, branchNumber) + staffingPurchaseModifier;
018151:   return {
018152:     matches,
018153:     price,
018154:     farOverBudget,
018155:     label: farOverBudget ? '予算を大きく超えている' : labels[matches],
018156:     chance: farOverBudget ? 0 : clamp(baseChance, 0.02, 0.95),
018157:   };
018158: }

018995: function giftSendableRows(category) {
018996:   if (!state?.inventory) return [];
018997:   if (category === 'rough') {
018998:     return Object.values(GEMS).map((gem) => {
018999:       const max = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.inventory.rough?.[gem.id]) || 0));
019000:       return { key: gem.id, name: roughDisplayName(gem.id), max, payload: { type: 'rough', id: gem.id, name: roughDisplayName(gem.id) } };
019001:     }).filter((row) => row.max > 0);
019002:   }
019003:   if (category === 'loose') {
019004:     const rows = [];
019005:     for (const gem of Object.values(GEMS)) {
019006:       for (const shapeId of looseShapeIdsForGem(gem.id)) {
019007:         const max = looseAvailableQuantity(gem.id, shapeId);
019008:         if (max <= 0) continue;
019009:         rows.push({
019010:           key: `${gem.id}|${shapeId}`,
019011:           name: looseDisplayLabel(gem.id, shapeId),
019012:           max,
019013:           payload: { type: 'loose', id: gem.id, shapeId, name: looseDisplayLabel(gem.id, shapeId, { suffix: true }) },
019014:         });
019015:       }
019016:     }
019017:     return rows;
019018:   }
019019:   if (category === 'item') {
019020:     return Object.values(GENERAL_ITEMS).map((item) => {
019021:       const max = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.inventory.items?.[item.id]) || 0));
019022:       return { key: item.id, name: item.name, max, payload: { type: 'item', id: item.id, name: item.name } };
019023:     }).filter((row) => row.max > 0);
019024:   }
019025:   if (category === 'metal') {
019026:     return Object.values(METALS).map((metal) => {
019027:       const max = Math.max(0, Math.floor(metalAvailableWeight(metal.id)));
019028:       return { key: metal.id, name: metal.shortName || metal.name, max, payload: { type: 'metal', id: metal.id, name: `${metal.shortName || metal.name}地金` } };
019029:     }).filter((row) => row.max >= 1);
019030:   }
019031:   if (category === 'jewelry') {
019032:     return (state.inventory.jewelry || []).filter((item) => item.status === 'stored').map((item) => ({
019033:       key: item.id,
019034:       name: item.name || '完成品',
019035:       max: 1,
019036:       payload: { type: 'jewelry', id: item.id, name: item.name || '完成品', itemData: structuredClone(item) },
019037:     }));
019038:   }
019039:   return [];
019040: }

019042: function normalizeGiftDraft() {
019043:   const categories = ['rough', 'loose', 'item', 'metal', 'jewelry'];
019044:   if (!categories.includes(giftDraft.category)) giftDraft.category = 'rough';
019045:   const rows = giftSendableRows(giftDraft.category);
019046:   if (!rows.some((row) => row.key === giftDraft.itemKey)) giftDraft.itemKey = rows[0]?.key || '';
019047:   const row = rows.find((entry) => entry.key === giftDraft.itemKey) || rows[0] || null;
019048:   if (!row) giftDraft.quantity = 1;
019049:   else giftDraft.quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.floor(row.max), Math.floor(Number(giftDraft.quantity) || 1)));
019050:   return { rows, row };
019051: }

019053: function syncGiftSendQuantityControls() {

019059:   const maximum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(row.max));

019076: function adjustGiftQuantity(delta) {
019077:   const { row } = normalizeGiftDraft();
019078:   if (!row || giftDraft.category === 'jewelry') return;
019079:   const maximum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(row.max));
019080:   const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(giftDraft.quantity) || 1));
019081:   giftDraft.quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(maximum, current + (Number(delta) < 0 ? -1 : 1)));
019082:   playSfx('select', { gain: 0.66 });
019083:   if (!syncGiftSendQuantityControls()) render();
019084: }

019104: function giftOutboxEntry(code, payload, status = 'pending') {

019116: function removeGiftFromGameState(gameState, payload, code) {
019117:   const inventory = gameState?.inventory;
019118:   if (!inventory) throw new Error('在庫データを確認できません。');
019119:   const quantity = payload.type === 'metal' ? giftRoundedWeight(payload.quantity) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(payload.quantity) || 1));
019120:   if (payload.type === 'rough') {
019121:     if (!GEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('原石データを確認できません。');
019122:     const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.rough?.[payload.id]) || 0));
019123:     if (current < quantity) throw new Error('原石の所持数が足りません。');
019124:     inventory.rough[payload.id] = current - quantity;
019125:   } else if (payload.type === 'loose') {
019126:     if (!GEMS[payload.id] || !looseShapeIdsForGem(payload.id).includes(payload.shapeId)) throw new Error('ルースデータを確認できません。');
019127:     const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.loose?.[payload.id]?.[payload.shapeId]) || 0));
019128:     if (current < quantity) throw new Error('ルースの所持数が足りません。');
019129:     inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId] = current - quantity;
019130:   } else if (payload.type === 'item') {
019131:     if (!GENERAL_ITEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('アイテムデータを確認できません。');
019132:     const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.items?.[payload.id]) || 0));
019133:     if (current < quantity) throw new Error('アイテムの所持数が足りません。');
019134:     inventory.items[payload.id] = current - quantity;
019135:   } else if (payload.type === 'metal') {
019136:     if (!METALS[payload.id]) throw new Error('地金データを確認できません。');
019137:     const current = giftRoundedWeight(inventory.metals?.[payload.id]);
019138:     if (quantity < 0.1 || current + 0.0001 < quantity) throw new Error('地金の所持重量が足りません。');
019139:     inventory.metals[payload.id] = giftRoundedWeight(current - quantity);
019140:   } else if (payload.type === 'jewelry') {
019141:     const index = (inventory.jewelry || []).findIndex((item) => item.id === payload.id && item.status === 'stored');
019142:     if (index < 0) throw new Error('この完成品は現在プレゼントにできません。');
019143:     inventory.jewelry.splice(index, 1);
019144:   } else throw new Error('プレゼントの種類を確認できません。');
019145:   const gifts = ensureGiftState(gameState);
019146:   gifts.outbox.unshift(giftOutboxEntry(code, payload, 'pending'));
019147:   gifts.outbox = gifts.outbox.slice(0, 50);
019148:   return gameState;
019149: }

019151: function addGiftToGameState(gameState, payload, code) {
019152:   const inventory = gameState?.inventory;
019153:   if (!inventory) throw new Error('在庫データを確認できません。');
019154:   const quantity = payload.type === 'metal' ? giftRoundedWeight(payload.quantity) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(payload.quantity) || 1));
019155:   if (payload.type === 'rough') {
019156:     if (!GEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('原石データを確認できません。');
019157:     inventory.rough[payload.id] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.rough?.[payload.id]) || 0)) + quantity;
019158:   } else if (payload.type === 'loose') {
019159:     if (!GEMS[payload.id] || !looseShapeIdsForGem(payload.id).includes(payload.shapeId)) throw new Error('ルースデータを確認できません。');
019160:     inventory.loose[payload.id] = inventory.loose[payload.id] || {};
019161:     inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId]) || 0)) + quantity;
019162:   } else if (payload.type === 'item') {
019163:     if (!GENERAL_ITEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('アイテムデータを確認できません。');
019164:     inventory.items[payload.id] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.items?.[payload.id]) || 0)) + quantity;
019165:   } else if (payload.type === 'metal') {
019166:     if (!METALS[payload.id]) throw new Error('地金データを確認できません。');
019167:     const current = giftRoundedWeight(inventory.metals?.[payload.id]);
019168:     const capacity = Math.max(0.1, Number(inventory.metalCapacity?.[payload.id]) || Number(METALS[payload.id].storageLimit) || 1);
019169:     if (current + quantity > capacity + 0.0001) throw new Error(`${METALS[payload.id].shortName || METALS[payload.id].name}の保管上限を超えるため受け取れません。`);
019170:     inventory.metals[payload.id] = giftRoundedWeight(current + quantity);
019171:   } else if (payload.type === 'jewelry') {
019172:     const used = (inventory.jewelry || []).filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
019173:     const capacity = finishedJewelryCapacity(gameState);
019174:     if (used >= capacity) throw new Error('完成品の保管場所に空きがありません。');
019175:     const item = structuredClone(payload.itemData || {});
019176:     if (!item.item || !ITEMS[item.item]) throw new Error('完成品データを確認できません。');
019177:     item.id = `gift-${String(code).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toLowerCase()}`;
019178:     item.status = 'stored';
019179:     item.receivedGiftCode = code;
019180:     item.receivedDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(gameState.game?.day) || 1));
019181:     delete item.displayBranchNumber;
019182:     delete item.orderId;
019183:     if ((inventory.jewelry || []).some((entry) => entry.id === item.id)) throw new Error('このプレゼントはすでに在庫へ追加されています。');
019184:     inventory.jewelry.push(item);
019185:   } else throw new Error('プレゼントの種類を確認できません。');
019186:   const gifts = ensureGiftState(gameState);
019187:   const summary = giftPayloadSummary(payload);
019188:   gifts.inbox.unshift({ code, ...summary, receivedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
019189:   gifts.inbox = gifts.inbox.slice(0, 50);
019190:   gameState.notifications = Array.isArray(gameState.notifications) ? gameState.notifications : [];
019191:   gameState.notifications.unshift({
019192:     id: `gift-${String(code).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toLowerCase()}-received`,
019193:     title: 'プレゼントを受け取りました',
019194:     body: `${summary.name} ${summary.quantity}を受け取りました。`,
019195:     type: 'special',
019196:     day: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(gameState.game?.day) || 1)),
019197:     unread: true,
019198:   });
019199:   return gameState;
019200: }

019752: function aiJewelryRows() {
019753:   const rows = [...(state.inventory.jewelry || []), ...(state.history?.soldJewelry || [])];
019754:   return rows.map((jewelry) => ({
019755:     id: jewelry.id,
019756:     name: jewelry.name || itemName(jewelry),
019757:     item: ITEMS[jewelry.item]?.name || jewelry.item,
019758:     gem: jewelry.useLoose === false ? 'ルースなし' : (GEMS[jewelry.gem]?.name || jewelry.gem),
019759:     looseShape: jewelry.useLoose === false ? 'なし' : (jewelry.gem === 'pearl' ? '表示なし' : looseShapeLabel(jewelry.looseShape)),

019997: function fallbackCopyText(text) {
019998:   const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
019999:   textarea.value = text;
020000:   textarea.setAttribute('readonly', '');
020001:   textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
020002:   textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
020003:   textarea.style.top = '0';

020013: async function copyGameDataForAI() {

020016:   try {
020017:     if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {

020020:     }

020375: function shuffleRockIndices() {
020376:   const values = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4];
020377:   for (let i = values.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
020378:     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
020379:     [values[i], values[j]] = [values[j], values[i]];
020380:   }
020381:   return values;
020382: }

020384: function pickRandomMiningRockImages(count = 5) {
020385:   const pool = [...MINING_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL];
020386:   for (let i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
020387:     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
020388:     [pool[i], pool[j]] = [pool[j], pool[i]];
020389:   }
020390:   return pool.slice(0, Math.max(0, count));
020391: }

020395:   const index = Math.floor(Math.random() * MINING_BROKEN_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL.length);
020396:   return MINING_BROKEN_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL[index];

020417: function updateRockVisual(button, hits) {
020418:   for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i += 1) button.classList.remove(`hit-${i}`);
020419:   button.classList.add(`hit-${hits}`);

020424: function finishMiningRock(index, button) {
020425:   if (!miningGame || miningGame.resolved) return;
020426:   miningGame.resolved = true;
020427:   button.classList.add('breaking');
020428:   root.querySelectorAll('.mining-rock').forEach((rock) => { rock.disabled = true; });

020436:     state.inventory.rough[gem] += 1;

020441:   }
020442:   saveGame();
020443:   setTimeout(() => {
020444:     if (success) {
020445:       playSfx('mining-win', { gain: 1.15 });
020446:       vibrate([55, 35, 85]);
020447:     } else {
020448:       playSfx('mining-miss', { gain: 1.12 });
020449:     }

020451:     setScreen('miningResult', { result }, false);
020452:   }, 560);
020453: }

020455: function hitMiningRock(index, button) {
020456:   if (!miningGame || miningGame.resolved || miningGame.busy) return;
020457:   if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= miningGame.hits.length) return;
020458:   miningGame.busy = true;
020459:   miningGame.hits[index] = Math.min(5, miningGame.hits[index] + 1);
020460:   const hits = miningGame.hits[index];
020461:   button.classList.remove('swinging');
020462:   void button.offsetWidth;
020463:   button.classList.add('swinging');
020464:   updateRockVisual(button, hits);
020465:   playSfx('impact', { gain: 1.12, rate: 0.92 + Math.random() * 0.16 });
020466:   vibrate([24, 12, 28]);
020467:   if (hits >= 5) {
020468:     setTimeout(() => finishMiningRock(index, button), 300);
020469:     return;
020470:   }
020471:   setTimeout(() => {
020472:     button.classList.remove('swinging');
020473:     if (miningGame) miningGame.busy = false;
020474:   }, 330);
020475: }

020477: function buyMetal(id) {
020478:   if (!metalMarketTradeReady()) return showToast('地金相場を確認できないため、現在は購入できません。', 'error');
020479:   const product = METALS[id];
020480:   if (!product) return showToast('この地金は購入できません。', 'error');
020481:   if (!canSpendHours(1)) return showToast('今日は購入手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
020482:   const quantity = metalTradeQuantity('buy', id);
020483:   const maximum = metalTradeMaximum('buy', id);
020484:   if (quantity < 1 || quantity > maximum) return showToast('購入する重量を▲▼で選んでください。', 'error');
020485:   const unitPrice = metalTradePricePerGram('buy', id);
020486:   const totalPrice = unitPrice * quantity;
020487:   if (state.game.money < totalPrice) return showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
020488:   if (metalOwnedWeight(id) + quantity > metalStorageLimit(id) + 1e-9) return showToast('地金の保管上限を超えています。', 'error');
020489:   state.game.money -= totalPrice;
020490:   state.inventory.metals[id] = roundedMetalWeight(metalOwnedWeight(id) + quantity);
020491:   startMoneyFeedback(-totalPrice);
020492:   spendHours(1);
020493:   addFinance(`${product.name}を${quantity}g購入`, 0, totalPrice);
020494:   metalTradeDraft.buy[id] = 1;
020495:   saveGame();
020496:   showToast(`${product.name}を${quantity}g購入しました`, 'info', false);
020497:   render();
020498: }
